models_evaluated: Techcyte Human Fecal Ova & Parasite (O&P) Detection Wet Mount Iodine Solution

links.outcome: AI-only versus AI plus operator review agreement with microscopy, negative specimen handling
links.effect: AI alone correctly identified 2/31 (6.45%) negatives; after operator review 29/29 (100%) concordance; overall PPA 96.62%, NPA 93.33% with review.
links.quote: Before operator review, most of negative specimens 29/31 (93.54%) were considered positive by the AI-based software due to artifact misclassification.

links.outcome: Whether operator verification of AI detections corrects AI errors (artifacts)
links.effect: Artifacts in 162/178 (91.01%) specimens on raw analysis; operator review dismissed them, raising PPA/NPA to 96.62%/93.33%.
links.quote: Operator review was essential for accurate interpretation, to avoid diagnostic issues, and mainly to discard artifact detections.

links.outcome: False negatives after AI plus operator review
links.effect: 8/178 (4.49%) specimens discordant or partially discordant; 5 false negatives after operator review.
links.quote: A total number of 8/178 (4.49%) specimens were discordant or partially discordant after operator review involving the lack of detection of microorganism etiologies by the AI-system compared to conventional microscopy ( Table 4 ).

links.outcome: AI-assisted diagnosis compared with conventional microscopy on same specimens
links.effect: AI plus operator review detected additional parasites in 74/178 (41.57%) specimens versus microscopy; kappa 0.865.
links.quote: After data analysis, there were a total of 74/178 (41.57%) specimens with additional parasite etiologies detected respect to conventional microscopy examination.

models_evaluated: Techcyte Human Fecal Ova & Parasite (O&P) Detection Wet Mount Iodine Solution

links.outcome: diagnostic performance as screening adjunct versus definitive diagnostic method
links.effect: Standalone AI detected only 109/147 (74.14%) positive and 2/31 (6.45%) negative specimens, whereas operator-reviewed screening achieved 96.62% PPA and 93.33% NPA.
links.quote: The results obtained in this study indicate that the proposed system should be regarded primarily as a screening tool to support conventional microscopy rather than as a definitive diagnostic method.

links.outcome: negative specimen identification before versus after operator review
links.effect: Correctly identified negative specimens increased from 2/31 initially to 29/31 after operator review due to discarding artifacts.
links.quote: This configuration explains the low number of correctly identified negative specimens (2/31) initially, and the high proportion of correctly identified negative specimens after operator review (29/31).
